Top-tier score of 95 with RSI 59.9 still in healthy bullish zone and confirmed MACD crossover, good fit for an open slot on a risk-on day.

decisions.briefing: Markets were mildly risk-on today with both NASDAQ and S&P 500 up 0.7%. With cash above the $500 threshold and 3 open slots, we deployed into two top-scoring momentum candidates (DOCN, GRAL) while leaving one slot and cash reserved since the rally wasn't a strong breakout.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices edged higher today, with the NASDAQ and S&P 500 both gaining 0.7%, reflecting steady but unspectacular buying interest across sectors. There was no single dominant news catalyst driving the move — it appears to be a continuation of the recent bullish momentum trend seen across the screened stock list. Many growth and tech names showed healthy MACD crossovers and RSI readings in bullish-but-not-overbought territory, suggesting orderly institutional buying rather than speculative chasing.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍走高,納斯達克與標普500指數同步上漲0.7%,反映市場買盤穩健但未見爆發性行情。今天並沒有單一重大新聞事件推動這波漲勢,較像是近期多頭動能的延續。多檔成長股及科技股的技術指標顯示MACD黃金交叉、RSI處於多頭區間但未達超買,顯示資金是穩健布局而非追高炒作。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, based on the idea that strong recent performance tends to continue in the short term. Today we picked DOCN and GRAL because their price, RSI, and MACD indicators all confirmed an established uptrend rather than just a single bullish signal.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資是指買入近期走勢強勁、持續上漲的股票,其邏輯是強勢表現在短期內往往會延續。今天我們選擇DOCN和GRAL,是因為它們的價格、RSI與MACD指標都共同確認了既有的上升趨勢,而非僅憑單一訊號進場。
